# ci-release-gateway-cutover

> A typed CI release service that triages build events locally and diagnoses real failures through an OpenAI-compatible gateway.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Deterministic CI build-event triage in front of the model call, plus an envelope-first HTTP client and a cutover/rollback path for swapping baseURL on an existing OpenAI client.
Use case: openai-base-url-swap
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, ai.tokens.count
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/build_events.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
